notes: kb/Work PB5620: the 2002 Format 1 (sequential) prints the END-OF-PAGE phrases before [ retry-phrase ] and WITH LOCK / WITH NO LOCK (§2002:14.8.47.1, rendered PDF page 580). writeStatement parses the one retryLockPhrases element in either place, so a sequential-file WRITE in the 2002 order compiles and runs at --std 2002 (it was COBOL2269); VersionConformancePass.ParseArm.GateRetryLockPlace refuses that place from 2014 (COBOL0902, §2014:E.2 item 29) and the 2014 place at 2002 (COBOL0900). The INVALID KEY half of SR2 stays COBOL1720 (write-invalid-key-sequential-org).
